staff.tapAnywhereSwitch: Tap anywhere to switch the order sound on.
staff.firstOrderTable: First order from a table you haven't confirmed. If someone is sitting there, Accept: it goes to the kitchen and the table stays open for their next orders.
staff.getsNumberWhen: Gets its number when you accept it
staff.leavesBoardCustomers: It leaves the board and the customer's phone says the counter couldn't accept it. This can't be undone.
staff.stepNotAllowed: That step isn't allowed from here — the order may have already moved on.
staff.cantRejectServed: This order can't be rejected any more — it has already been served.
staff.numberingDown: New orders aren't getting today's numbers right now, so they show their older short number instead. Orders still come in as normal. ({message})
staff.newOrdersAppear: New orders appear here the moment a customer taps Place order.

openTables.noneNewGroups: None. A new group's first order waits for you to accept it.
openTables.doWhenGroup: Do it when the group has left: the next order from this table will wait for you to accept it.

totalWarning.totalDoesntMatch: Total doesn't match menu — check before charging

notSetUp.accountIsntSet: Your account isn't set up yet — ask the owner to add you. You are signed in, but this account has not been given a staff role, so the order board stays locked.
notSetUp.inviteLink: The owner can send you an invite link from Owner dashboard → Staff, or run, from the project:

friendlyErrors.signInMismatch: That email and password don't match.
friendlyErrors.invalidEmail: That doesn't look like an email address.
friendlyErrors.tooManyTries: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again — or ask the owner to reset your password.
friendlyErrors.signInNetwork: Can't reach the sign-in server. Check the wifi and try again.
friendlyErrors.userDisabled: This account has been switched off. Ask the owner.
friendlyErrors.emailSignInOff: Email sign-in isn't switched on for this cafe yet. The owner needs to enable it in the Firebase console.
friendlyErrors.weakPassword: Pick a longer password: at least 6 characters.
friendlyErrors.emailInUse: That email already has an account. Enter its password to sign in.
friendlyErrors.writeDenied: The database refused that change. The order may have already moved on — the board will catch up in a moment.
friendlyErrors.saveDropped: Couldn't save — the connection dropped. Try again.
friendlyErrors.saveSlow: Couldn't save — the connection is slow. Try again.
friendlyErrors.signedOutUpdate: You've been signed out. Sign in again to update orders.
friendlyErrors.updateFailed: Couldn't update that order. Try again.
friendlyErrors.readDenied: This account isn't allowed to read past orders. Sign in with the owner account, or check that it has a staff record.
friendlyErrors.signedOutHistory: You've been signed out. Sign in again to see past orders.
friendlyErrors.readDropped: Can't reach the database — the connection dropped. Try again.
friendlyErrors.readSlow: The database took too long to answer. Try again, or pick a shorter range.
friendlyErrors.quotaUsed: Today's free database allowance is used up. History will load again tomorrow.
friendlyErrors.teamDenied: The database refused that change. Only an owner can manage the team.
friendlyErrors.teamGone: That person or invite is already gone.
friendlyErrors.signedOut: You've been signed out. Sign in again.
friendlyErrors.inviteRefused: This invite doesn't work any more: it was used, cancelled or has expired. Ask the owner for a new link.

history.pickBoth: Pick both a start and an end date.
history.endBeforeStart: The end date is before the start date.
history.rangeTooLong: That's {days} days. History looks back at most {max} days at a time, so each look stays inside the free database allowance — pick a shorter range, or use Reports for monthly totals.
history.lookUpAny: Look up any past order. The live board is on the Orders screen.
history.tryAnotherDay: Try another day, or a longer range.
history.orderNumberLike: An order number like 0007, or an item like chai.
history.ordersWaiting: {orders} waiting for the counter, not counted yet.
history.salesNote: Sales are added up from each order's items, including orders still being made — the same figures as Reports.
history.capped: This range has more than {limit} orders, so only the newest {limit} were loaded. Pick a shorter range to see the rest.
history.menuDiffers: Differs from today's menu: {notes} Usually that is a menu change since the order was placed.

integrity.totalMismatch: Order says {total}, but its items add up to {sum}.
integrity.priceDiffers: {name}: {ordered} on the order, {menu} on the menu.

qr.qrCodeAny: A QR code for any other number is turned away. Changes reach customers' phones straight away.
qr.printPageCut: Print this page, cut along the lines, and put one card on each table. A card keeps working until you make a new code for its table, or change the address below.
qr.liveSiteAddress: Your live site address, e.g. https://yourcafe.web.app
qr.enterFullAddress: Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://
qr.scanOpenMenu: Scan to open the menu and order
qr.noAppNeeded: No app needed. Pay at the counter.
qr.cardTableStops: The card on the table stops working straight away. Print this card again and put it out.
qr.newCodeMade: New code made. Print this card and replace the old one.
qr.makeNewCodeQuestion: Make a new code for table {table}?

adminLayout.pageChangesMenu: This page changes your menu and shows your sales. Sign in on the staff screen with the owner account.
adminLayout.youreSignedStaff: You're signed in as staff, so you can run the order board — but menu edits and sales reports belong to the owner account.

dashboard.oneShortLine: One short line pinned to the top of the customer menu.
dashboard.notLiveYet: Not live yet. Tap Save to show customers.
dashboard.name: Name
dashboard.emptyDemoBody: Tap Add item to add your first drink, start from a starter menu, or restore the sample menu below.
dashboard.emptyBody: Tap Add item to add your first drink, or start from a starter menu.
dashboard.confirmRemove: Remove "{name}" from the menu? Past orders keep it.
dashboard.demoReplaces: Demo data only. This replaces the current menu with {count} sample items.
dashboard.confirmReplaceSamples: Replace the whole menu with the samples?
dashboard.priceDecimals: Enter a price above 0, with up to {digits} decimals.
dashboard.needNamePrice: Give the item a name and a valid price.
dashboard.needCategory: Give the new category a name.

reports.ordersPlacedCustomer: Orders placed on the customer side show up here the moment they are completed.
reports.demoDataAdd: Demo data. Add another sample month to compare periods.
reports.ordersNeverDeleted: Orders are never deleted automatically — six months of history is the target, and every figure above is recomputed from the full order list.

rejectedLeftOut.one: {count} rejected order is left out of these figures.
rejectedLeftOut.other: {count} rejected orders are left out of these figures.

reports.rejectedInCsv: They are in the CSV, marked “rejected”.

pendingWaiting.one: {count} order is still waiting for the counter to confirm the table, and not counted yet.
pendingWaiting.other: {count} orders are still waiting for the counter to confirm the table, and not counted yet.

reports.pendingInCsv: They are in the CSV, marked “pending”.

totalMismatchTitle.one: {count} order has a total that doesn't match its items
totalMismatchTitle.other: {count} orders have a total that doesn't match their items

reports.totalMismatchBody: ({numbers}). The revenue above is added up from the items, not those totals — check these against what the till actually took.

differsFromMenu.one: {count} order has items priced or named differently from today's menu ({numbers}). Usually that is a menu change since they were placed; if the menu has not changed, look at them.
differsFromMenu.other: {count} orders have items priced or named differently from today's menu ({numbers}). Usually that is a menu change since they were placed; if the menu has not changed, look at them.

team.couldntLoadTeam: Couldn't load the team. Check the connection and reload.
team.linksNobodyHas: Links nobody has used yet. Cancel one you sent to the wrong person.
team.staffRunOrder: Staff run the order board. Owners also get this dashboard.
team.anyoneLinkCan: Anyone with this link can join, so send it only to them.
team.youreOnlyOwner: You're the only owner. Make someone else an owner before you step down.
team.inviteIntro: Make an invite link and send it to them. It works once, for {days} days. They sign up with their own email and password.
team.removeStaffQuestion: Remove {name}? They keep their login but can't open the order board.
team.removeOwnerQuestion: Remove {name}? They keep their login but can't open the order board or this dashboard.

join.copyWholeInvite: Copy the whole invite link from the message the owner sent, or ask them for a new one.
join.inviteDoesntWork: This invite doesn't work any more
join.name: Your name
join.least6Characters: At least 6 characters. Already have an account? Use its password.
join.expiredBody: It has expired: invites work for seven days. Ask the owner for a new link.
join.usedBody: It has been used or cancelled. Ask the owner for a new link.
join.enterName: Enter your name, as the team will see it.
join.wrongPassword: That email already has an account, and that isn't its password.
join.onTheTeam: You're on the team as {role}. Sign in with this email and password on any device.
join.signedInAs: This device is signed in as {who}. To join as someone else with this invite, sign out first.

menuImport.tooBig: {name} is too big to be a menu. Choose its CSV file.
menuImport.cantRead: Couldn't read {name}. Try saving it as CSV again.
menuImport.confirmReplace: Replace all {items} on the menu with these {count}? Past orders keep theirs.
menuImport.importFailed: The import didn't save. Try again.
menuImport.introDecimals: Paste rows from a spreadsheet, or choose a CSV file. The columns are {columns}, in that order or under a header row. Name, category and price are needed; prices in {symbol}, up to {digits} decimals; available is yes or no.
menuImport.introWhole: Paste rows from a spreadsheet, or choose a CSV file. The columns are {columns}, in that order or under a header row. Name, category and price are needed; prices in {symbol}, whole numbers; available is yes or no.
menuImport.starterIntro: A whole menu to edit rather than type. You'll see every item before anything is added, and can change any of them later.
menuImport.starterPrices: Prices are a starting point: set your own.
menuImport.starterNoPrices: Prices are left empty for {currency}: fill them in before importing.

tableCodes.couldntLoadTable: Couldn't load your table codes. Check your connection and reload this page.
tableCodes.everyTableHas: ✓ Every table has a code. Only someone who scanned the card on a table can order for it.
tableCodes.didntSaveCheck: That didn't save. Check your connection and try again.
tableCodes.nowPrintCards: Now print the cards below and put them out.
tableCodes.noneHave: Right now anyone who knows your web address can order for any table without being in the cafe.

someMissing.one: Table {list} has no code yet, so anyone who knows the address can order for it from anywhere.
someMissing.other: Tables {list} have no code yet, so anyone who knows the address can order for them from anywhere.

tableCodes.explain: A code is a secret part of the table's QR code. Orders without it are turned away. After creating codes, print the cards below and replace the old ones — the old cards stop working.

tableList.separateCommasDash: Separate with commas. A dash covers a run, e.g. 1-8, 12, 14
tableList.savedCustomersNow: Saved ✓ Customers now see these tables.
tableList.didntSaveCheck: That didn't save. Check your connection and try again.
tableList.notSavedYet: Not saved yet. The cards below still show the saved tables.
tableList.chooseCount: Choose a number of tables from 1 to {max}.
tableList.cantUse: Can't use {list}. Table numbers go from 1 to {max}.
tableList.typeNumbers: Skip a number or start higher? Type the table numbers instead
tableList.usingDefault: Using the default ({list}) until you save.

newGuests.explain: Off: every order goes straight to the kitchen. On: a table's first order waits for staff to tap Accept, and then its orders go straight through for {hours} hours.

siteMaintenance.staffBanner: The site is in maintenance: customers can't order from their tables. Orders already placed carry on here as usual.
siteMaintenance.adminBanner: CafeMenu has put your site into maintenance. Customers see a “back soon” page and can't order; this dashboard and the staff board work as usual. The reason is in CafeMenu's email to you and on your cafe's page in the CafeMenu console. Only CafeMenu can end it.
siteMaintenance.adminScheduled: CafeMenu will put your site into maintenance {when}. The reason is in CafeMenu's email to you and on your cafe's page in the CafeMenu console.
siteMaintenance.adminLeft: Left CafeMenu while this was on? <link>How to end it yourself</link>.
siteMaintenance.ownerBanner: Your site is in maintenance: customers see a “back soon” page and can't order.
siteMaintenance.title: Maintenance mode
siteMaintenance.explain: Pause ordering for a holiday, a renovation or a menu change. Customers see a “back soon” page with your message; orders already placed, the staff board and this dashboard keep working.
siteMaintenance.messageHint: Optional. Up to 280 characters; without one they read “We're making a few changes”.
siteMaintenance.untilHint: Optional: shown to customers. Your cafe's time ({zone}).
siteMaintenance.startsAtHint: Leave empty to start now. Your cafe's time ({zone}).
siteMaintenance.endsAtHint: Leave empty to end it yourself. Your cafe's time ({zone}).
siteMaintenance.adminToo: CafeMenu's own maintenance is on as well: only CafeMenu can end that one.
siteMaintenance.didntSave: That didn't save. Check the connection and try again.

problems.endsFirst: The end has to come after the start.
problems.badTime: That isn't a date and time.
